common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

fields.usernameHint: 3 to 32 characters. It has nothing to do with your email accounts.

welcome.heading: Welcome to Buzón
welcome.body: In a few steps you'll create the administrator, adjust the server and, if you like, add your first email account.

admin.heading: Create the administrator
admin.body: You'll use this user to sign in to Buzón and invite other people. It is separate from your email login.

server.heading: Server settings
server.publicUrlHint: Used in invitation links. For example, https://mail.example.com

look.heading: Choose how it looks
look.body: You can change this any time in Settings.

account.heading: Add your first email account
account.body: These are your mail server details. The password is stored encrypted.
account.later: The server connection will be checked once syncing arrives.

look.modeHint: Focus screens new senders and splits Main, News and Receipts. Classic shows the usual folders. Switching deletes nothing.
look.densityHint: Compact trims spacing, never the text size.
look.preview: There are eight of us on Saturday. Can you bring the wine? Il1 O0 rn m

login.title: Sign in to Buzón
login.totpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

invite.title: Create your Buzón user
invite.body: You've been invited to Buzón. Choose a username and password; you'll add your email accounts afterwards.
invite.invalid: This invitation link has expired or was already used. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.
invite.totpOfferBody: Besides your password, we'll ask for a code from your phone when you sign in. It protects your email even if someone learns your password.

home.emptyBody: Reading and syncing mail arrive in the next phase. Meanwhile, you can make Buzón your own.
home.noAccounts: You don't have any email accounts yet.

totp.title: Two-step verification
totp.on: On. You'll be asked for a code from your authenticator app when you sign in.
totp.off: Off. Turn it on to protect your account even if someone knows your password.
totp.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app (for example Aegis, 2FAS or Google Authenticator).
totp.manual: If you can't scan it, type this key:
totp.disablePrompt: Enter your password to turn it off.

invitations.title: Invite someone
invitations.body: Create a link and send it to them. It expires after 72 hours and works only once.
invitations.notePlaceholder: Who it's for (only you see this)
invitations.created: Link created. Copy it now: it won't be shown again.
